explanation: Its pounding rhythms and Nijinsky's stamping choreography split the audience, and supporters and opponents shouted at each other. A concert performance in Paris the next year was cheered.

Vaslav Nijinsky choreographed the original production of The Rite of Spring.

A concert performance of The Rite of Spring in Paris in April 1914 was a triumph.
